subject: general
question: In which year was the National Organic Chemicals Industries Limited (NOCIL) established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1961**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• National Organic Chemicals Industries Limited (NOCIL) was established in the year 1961.
 
• NOCIL is one of the oldest and largest rubber chemical manufacturers in India.
 
• The company has a strong presence in both the domestic and international markets.
 
• NOCIL is known for its commitment to quality and innovation in the chemical industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Organic Chemicals Industries Limited (NOCIL)**

 
 
• NOCIL is a part of the Arvind Mafatlal Group, one of the oldest industrial houses in India.
 
• The company is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of rubber chemicals.
 
• Its products are used in various industries, including automotive, construction, and manufacturing.
 
• NOCIL's manufacturing facilities are located in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, and Dahej, Gujarat.
 
 
 
• **Rubber Chemicals**
 
 
• Rubber chemicals are essential additives used in the processing and production of rubber products.
 
• They include accelerators, antioxidants, vulcanizing agents, and processing aids.
 
• These chemicals enhance the properties of rubber, making it more durable, flexible, and resistant to heat and aging.
 
• Rubber chemicals are critical in the production of tires, hoses, belts, and other rubber goods.
 
 
 
• **Arvind Mafatlal Group**
 
 
• The Arvind Mafatlal Group is a diversified business conglomerate with interests in textiles, chemicals, and information technology.
 
• The group has a rich history dating back to the early 20th century.
 
• It is known for its commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainability in all its business ventures.
 
• The group has a strong focus on corporate social responsibility and community development initiatives.
